# Verification rules: what the meta-model file needs, so that the errors are found while modelling.
for each e in (classifier union rule union abstraction_level):
otherwise "{e} must belong to a meta model."
for each r in Relationship except belongs_to:
otherwise "{r.start} is linked to {r.end} by {r.type}, so {r.end} must belong to every meta model that {r.start} belongs to."
for each p in (type_label union type_shape) where in_diagram is not empty:
otherwise "{p} is used in diagram type {p.in_diagram}, so that must belong to every meta model that {p.parent} belongs to."
otherwise "Type {t} needs a name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter."
otherwise "Stereotype {s} must have the name of a stereotype of the core model, such as Entity."
otherwise "Attribute {a} needs a name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter."
for each p in (attribute union type_label union type_shape):
otherwise "{p} must be part of the type or stereotype it belongs to."
otherwise "Type {t} can extend only one type."
for each t in model_type where targets(extends) is not empty:
otherwise "Type {t} can only extend a type of the same kind."
otherwise "Port type {p} needs the types of entities its ports belong to (owned_by)."
require r.targets(starts_at) is not empty and r.targets(ends_at) is not empty
otherwise "Relationship type {r} needs the types it starts and ends at (starts_at and ends_at)."
otherwise "Hierarchy type {h} needs one parent type and one child type (has_parent and has_child)."
otherwise "Breakdown type {b} needs one aggregate and one constituent relationship type."
otherwise "Chain type {c} needs the one relationship type its chains consist of (chain_of)."
otherwise "Instantiation type {i} needs the one template type it instantiates."
otherwise "Template type {t} can have only one instantiation type."
for each r in rule where sources(uses_rule) is not empty:
otherwise "Rule {r} is used by a diagram type, so it must be a generation rule, starting with 'diagram'."
for each d in diagram_type where kind != sequence:
otherwise "Diagram type {d} has no generation rules, so its diagrams can only be drawn."
